this is an unconfirmed opinion and the Cloud offset is not yet reported.", "claim_ids": ["synthetic_000049.c1", "synthetic_000049.c6"], "sections": [{"email_id": "synthetic_000049", "quote": "Two of the three colo operators and one neocloud contact independently described Google-managed TPU pods being installed, or contracted for installation, in third-party facilities."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000049", "quote": "It would show TPUs becoming a merchant-style product, which changes the competitive framing against GPU-based clouds and could raise capex beyond the ~$185bn Street 2027 figure if the hardware sits on Google's balance sheet."}]}, {"kind": "existing_thesis", "pillar_id": "NVDA.p3", "stance": "contradicts", "strength": 1, "wrong_if_met": false, "assumptions": [], "rationale": "A large customer's in-house TPUs being offered as a merchant-style product to external customers cuts against the idea that in-house chips only grow alongside Nvidia, though the sites sit near existing GPU clusters and no move of most new capacity is reported.", "claim_ids": ["synthetic_000049.c4", "synthetic_000049.c6"], "sections": [{"email_id": "synthetic_000049", "quote": "The former Google contact said the purpose is to serve external customers who want TPU capacity inside their own preferred regions or near existing GPU clusters, rather than to relieve Google's internal capacity."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000049", "quote": "It would show TPUs becoming a merchant-style product, which changes the competitive framing against GPU-based clouds and could raise capex beyond the ~$185bn Street 2027 figure if the hardware sits on Google's balance sheet."}]}], "no_change_reason": null}}
